summary: Kirk Creek (Los Padres NF, Big Sur): open; rate now $47 (stored $45); rec.gov reservable with 2 first-come sites, 14-night max; 32 bookable sites, every RV site 26-56 ft per rec.gov (FS page says 30 ft max); no hookups, no water, vault toilets; year-round with winter road-closure caution. --AWH note and coastal dunes untouched.
flags: WATERFRONT (--AWH, not changed; disagreement reported only): stored 'coastal dunes'. The sites sit on an open grassy bluff ~30 m (100 ft) above the surf, with a 'short walk to a rocky beach'; Highway 1 is inland (east) of the camp, so nothing developed separates the bluff from the ocean, but there is no dune field. Under the current vocabulary it would read as 'coastal walk' (ocean within an easy walk, own beach trail).

SITE LENGTH: FS page says 'Recreational Vehicles no longer than 30 feet'; the rec.gov catalog gives 26-56 ft per site. Either way a 23-ft rig fits every RV site. max_rig_ft written from rec.gov (trusted over the FS page).
SITE COUNT: rec.gov catalog 32 reservable sites; FS page says 40 sites including 2 first-come. Count left unwritten.
